payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the specific DVD shown in the small rectangular case near the center of the source image change from black to white in the edited image?
node.criteria: Compare the source object near the center—a small rectangular DVD case with a visible disc/image—to the corresponding object in the edited image, using location, shape, and context. Do not treat separate newly visible white disc-like objects as the target. Complete if the corresponding DVD itself is white; partial if it has visibly changed from black toward white but is not white; absent if it remains black with no requested color change; unknown if the target or its correspondence cannot be established reliably.
node.binding: Target: the small rectangular DVD case near the center of the source image, identifiable by its rectangular outline and visible disc/image. Reference: that same DVD object in the edited image, matched by location, shape, and context; do not bind to separate white disc-like objects. If correspondence is uncertain, report unknown.

outcome.description: Change the DVD from black to white.
